_about: Vedic monthly prediction templates keyed by Sun's transit house from natal Moon (Chandra Lagna). Each entry has a 'high'/'low' variant selected by the Sarvashtavarga point band — high (≥30 bindus) softens malefic indications, low (<25) intensifies them; mid (25–29) uses 'neutral'. Jupiter's house from natal Moon supplies a secondary modifier appended when relevant.

1.high: Sun transits your Moon-sign — your sense of self is highlighted but the favourable Sarvashtavarga support helps you stay centred. You can take on visible roles, lead initiatives, and command respect. Health is generally stable.
1.neutral: Sun transiting your Moon-sign brings the spotlight to you. Manage your energy carefully, take care of your body and avoid confrontations with authority figures. Use this period for self-reflection and reset.
1.low: Sun transits your Moon-sign with weak Sarvashtavarga support. Expect mental restlessness, fatigue, and friction with authority. Avoid risky decisions; conserve energy and rest.

2.high: Sun in the 2nd from Moon with strong Sarvashtavarga points supports income, family stability and confident communication. A good window to negotiate, present ideas, or finalise financial plans.
2.neutral: Sun in the 2nd from Moon — focus on finances, family obligations and what you say. Some mild tension around money or food is possible; keep speech measured.
2.low: Sun in the 2nd from Moon with weak support flags eye-strain, throat issues and disputes around money or food. Tighten the budget and avoid harsh speech.

3.high: Sun in the 3rd from Moon (Upachaya) with strong points is excellent — push initiatives, sign agreements, and take calculated risks. Siblings or peers actively support you.
3.neutral: Sun in the 3rd from Moon favours bold action and short trips. Initiatives launched now grow over time. Possible minor friction with siblings; address it head-on.
3.low: Sun in the 3rd from Moon — courage is tested, energy needs to be channelled. Without Sarvashtavarga support, expect short-trip hassles and disputes with siblings.

4.high: Sun in the 4th from Moon stresses home and emotional foundations even with strong points. Spend time with family, restore the home base, and avoid stoking old conflicts.
4.neutral: Sun in the 4th from Moon — domestic concerns, mother's health, or property matters demand attention. Inner restlessness is common; ground yourself with routine.
4.low: Sun in the 4th from Moon with weak Sarvashtavarga points warns of conflict at home, troubles for mother or property losses. Keep peace and avoid major real-estate decisions.

5.high: Sun in the 5th from Moon with strong points lights up creative pursuits and brings recognition to your work. Children prosper; speculative gains possible (with prudence).
5.neutral: Sun in the 5th from Moon highlights children, creative output and speculative ventures. Stay measured — the Sun here can also drive arrogance.
5.low: Sun in the 5th from Moon — concerns regarding children or creative blocks. Avoid speculation; use the time to learn rather than gamble.

6.high: Sun in the 6th from Moon (Upachaya) with strong points is a power period for defeating opponents, clearing debts and excelling at work. Push hard at competitive tasks.
6.neutral: Sun in the 6th from Moon favours work output and conflict resolution. Watch your diet to prevent stomach issues; clear pending obligations.
6.low: Sun in the 6th from Moon with low Sarvashtavarga support points to overwork, digestive trouble or workplace politics. Pace yourself and avoid lending money.

7.high: Sun in the 7th from Moon — even a strong Sarvashtavarga reading does not fully soften this transit. Expect a busy public period; be diplomatic with partners and clients.
7.neutral: Sun in the 7th from Moon stresses partnerships. Avoid major contracts or confrontations with spouse/business partners; the energy is ego-charged.
7.low: Sun in the 7th from Moon with weak support warns of separation, partnership disputes, and travel exhaustion. Postpone weddings, partnerships and signings if possible.

8.high: Sun in the 8th from Moon — even with strong Sarvashtavarga points, this is a low-key, internal period. Avoid risky exposure, undertake research and rest.
8.neutral: Sun in the 8th from Moon brings hidden obstacles and a dip in vitality. Avoid surgery, lawsuits and high-stakes decisions; protect health and finances.
8.low: Sun in the 8th from Moon with weak support is one of the most challenging transits — expect health setbacks, sudden expenses, and ego wounds. Be conservative.

9.high: Sun in the 9th from Moon with strong points blesses you with luck, paternal support and meaningful travel. Pilgrimages, higher studies and ethical decisions thrive.
9.neutral: Sun in the 9th from Moon favours long-distance travel, learning and connection with mentors. Father may need attention; honour elders.
9.low: Sun in the 9th from Moon with weak Sarvashtavarga support flags travel obstacles and friction with father/teacher figures. Keep ethics tight; avoid shortcuts.

10.high: Sun in the 10th from Moon with strong Sarvashtavarga support is a peak career window. Expect promotions, recognition, and successful negotiations with authorities.
10.neutral: Sun in the 10th from Moon energises career and public standing. Aim high but stay humble — visibility brings scrutiny too.
10.low: Sun in the 10th from Moon with weak support warns of conflicts with bosses and reputation risks. Deliver consistently rather than seeking limelight.

11.high: Sun in the 11th from Moon with strong points brings income, fulfilled goals and influential contacts. Excellent for networking and asking for raises.
11.neutral: Sun in the 11th from Moon supports gains and networking. Existing initiatives ripen; seek mentors and benefactors.
11.low: Sun in the 11th from Moon — even a malefic-friendly house cannot fully overcome weak Sarvashtavarga support. Manage expectations on income; don't overcommit.

12.high: Sun in the 12th from Moon — the Sarvashtavarga cushion helps, but the period still tilts toward retreat, foreign matters and spiritual practice rather than visible action.
12.neutral: Sun in the 12th from Moon brings expenses, sleep disturbances and a need for solitude. Use the time for inner work and to wind down current cycles.
12.low: Sun in the 12th from Moon with weak Sarvashtavarga support warns of losses, isolation and foot/eye troubles. Pull back, cut expenses, and rest.

jupiterFromMoonModifier.1: Jupiter on your Moon-sign brings expansion of self and inner growth, but can also bring weight gain or complacency.
jupiterFromMoonModifier.2: Jupiter in the 2nd from Moon supports family wealth and refined speech; mind overconsumption.
jupiterFromMoonModifier.3: Jupiter in the 3rd from Moon (a difficult position for Jupiter) can shrink courage and overload you with small responsibilities.
jupiterFromMoonModifier.4: Jupiter in the 4th from Moon adds mental ease, vehicle/property gains and supportive home conditions.
jupiterFromMoonModifier.5: Jupiter in the 5th from Moon is excellent — children, creativity, and intelligent decisions all benefit.
jupiterFromMoonModifier.6: Jupiter in the 6th from Moon (a difficult position) signals workplace strain and potential debt issues despite hard work.
jupiterFromMoonModifier.7: Jupiter in the 7th from Moon supports partnerships, marriage, and harmonious negotiations.
jupiterFromMoonModifier.8: Jupiter in the 8th from Moon highlights legacy, inheritance and hidden research — slow but profound shifts.
jupiterFromMoonModifier.9: Jupiter in the 9th from Moon is highly auspicious — luck, dharma, mentors and travel all flow.
jupiterFromMoonModifier.10: Jupiter in the 10th from Moon (a difficult position) can dilute professional focus; deliver results without overpromising.
jupiterFromMoonModifier.11: Jupiter in the 11th from Moon brings significant gains and powerful network growth.
jupiterFromMoonModifier.12: Jupiter in the 12th from Moon supports spiritual progress and foreign opportunities, but watch for unnecessary expenses.
